photos.title: Carolina Forest from above: streets of houses around ponds, with the boulevard across the middle
photos.what: Part of Carolina Forest from the air (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): a divided boulevard across the middle, curving streets of houses around ponds on both sides, a ball field and a townhome block at the upper right, pine woods and wetland between neighborhoods, and the Waterway's canals at the lower right.
photos.caption: Carolina Forest from the air: streets of houses around ponds, with the boulevard across the middle.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of part of Carolina Forest: a divided boulevard crossing the picture, curving streets of houses around ponds on both sides, pine woods and wetland between them, and canals at the lower right
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023 (from the image service's primary mosaic at the frame), natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
